title: Replaces the generic fraud rejection reason with specific fraud reasons
summary: Replaces the generic fraud value for the reason parameter when rejecting an account with more specific fraud reasons: The reason parameter changes from a string to an enum that doesn’t include fraud as a value. Requests that pass fraud return an HTTP 400 error.

migrationNotes.text: If your integration rejects connected accounts for suspected fraud, update it to use one of the new fraud reasons that best describes the suspected activity. Use fraud_other when none of the more specific reasons apply.
Update your integration to use the new reason enum, including calls that continue to use terms_of_service or other.

sources.quote: | [Replaces the generic fraud rejection reason with specific fraud reasons](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/updated-reject-reason-codes.md) | Connect | Breaking | api |
The `reason` parameter changes from a string to an enum that doesn’t include `fraud` as a value. Requests that pass `fraud` return an HTTP `400` error.
